review_candidates.title: IT Operations Manager Featured
review_candidates.description_excerpt: You'll oversee the service desk, field support, end-user technology, networks and connectivity, Microsoft 365 administration, cybersecurity operations, IT assets, infrastructure projects, and operational technology vendors. Maintain an effective on-call framework for 24/7 critical support. Maintain practical and effective IT documentation, including diagrams, procedures, runbooks, and knowledge-base content. Identify opportunities to use AI securely and effectively to improve IT service delivery
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a hands-on IT leadership role for someone who can lead people, projects, and service providers while remaining technically engaged in the systems that keep a complex, multi-site operation running. Help strengthen cybersecurity practices in alignment with recognized frameworks and operational requirements. At least five years of progressive experience in IT operations, infrastructure, or systems administration. Strong hands-on Microsoft 365 administration experience, including Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and Intune. An understanding of confidentiality, privacy, audit, and information governance requirements. If you're an experienced IT professional who enjoys building better systems, solving complex problems, leading a lean team, and staying hands-on, we'd like to hear from you.
